def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Gridline rows/columns are the ones uniformly colored with 9.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 9 for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h))]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] != 9 else 0 for c in cols] for r in rows]
    bg = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (9, 7, 2)), 0)

    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for r in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for c in range(len(cols) - 1):
            a, b = nodes[r][c], nodes[r][c + 1]
            d, e = nodes[r + 1][c], nodes[r + 1][c + 1]
            if a != 0 and a == b == d == e:
                out[r][c] = a
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Lattice lines are the rows and columns made entirely of the frame
    # color, except for occasional colored markers at their intersections.
    line_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if all(v in (9, 7, 2) for v in row)]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                 if all(grid[r][c] in (9, 7, 2) for r in range(h))]

    # Use the dominant non-line color as the output background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (9, 7, 2))
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else 0

    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(line_cols) - 1)]

    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)

    # Identify the lattice color by how many nearly uniform rows and columns it makes.

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)

    from collections import Counter

    freq = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    frame = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    background = freq.most_common(2)[1][0]

    # Lattice lines are almost entirely the most frequent color; marker
    # colors can replace a small number of cells at their intersections.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == frame for x in grid[r]) >= w - 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == frame for r in range(h)) >= h - 2]

    result = [[background for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
              for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != frame and corners[0] != background and all(
                    x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                result[i][j] = corners[0]
    return result
